items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: But it was really an experience working with him, because I never heard a trombone player play like that

ctx.x: But in talking to him about this, he was saying that in some ways, you couldn't play like that when you were playing with a section, because technically, there are certain sounds that you had to... I guess like violinists bowing, you had to use the slide a different way. All of this a trombone player would understand.

But it was really an experience working with him, because I never heard a trombone player play like that, and play that fast and with that much articulation -- and he really knew what he was doing, you know! He was also an excellent arranger, you know.
